Wish.title: Wedding Wish
Wish.description: A heartfelt blessing or congratulatory message posted by a wedding guest on the shared guestbook wall.

name.description: Display name of the guest sending the blessing.

relation.description: Guest relationship to the bride or groom.

avatar.description: Single-character monogram initial for the wish avatar.

likes.description: Total heart likes received on this blessing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wish was submitted.

QuizReply.title: Wedding Quiz Reply
QuizReply.description: A guest's quiz score and playful reply posted after completing the Shirsh & Tanu couple quiz.

name.description: Guest name who played the quiz.

scoreText.description: Quiz result badge such as '5/5 • Royal VIP'.

reply.description: Guest reply or playful note for the couple.

avatar.description: Single-character monogram initial for the guest.

likes.description: Total heart likes received on this quiz reply.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quiz reply was submitted.

/wishes/{wishId}.description: Public collection of shared wedding wishes visible to all wedding invitation visitors.

/quiz_replies/{replyId}.description: Public collection of guest couple quiz replies and likes.
